Mereseiret tehakse jätkuna eelmiste aastate seirele. See tähendab, et proovivõtt ja analüüs peab jätkuma vastavates seirejaamades (aegridade jätkamine) ja tagades kõiki kvaliteedinõudeid, mis on seatud nii riigisiseste kui rahvusvaheliste õigusaktidega. The mission architecture consists of a constellation of three spacecraft placed at the vertexes of a near-equilateral triangle with side length of about 2.5 million km (LISA Constellation). The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the subcontractor for the LISA Core Assembly Thermal and Contamination Protection (LCA TCP) System.
The LCA TCP System’s primary function is to thermally decouple critical components within LCA from LISA platform. Secondary function is the protection of these same components from both particle and light contamination. TCP System is considered critical for achieving and maintaining the required performance of the LISA payload throughout the mission, by creating and maintaining specified operational environment within the LCA both on ground and in orbit.
